summary: The partial-adoption convergence check tries the seeds known to run into its deliberate bug first, so it needs one round of four seeds instead of two; a seed that stops running into it still falls back to the others.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to try the seeds in their listed order again.
